messages.text: Def interested in getting one will order it ASAP. They are shipping for sure on the 31st? What is the price after that point?

Hi Nathan,

Good news on the BS-4. It's live right now at $599.99 for the 18 TH/s unit, plug matched to your address, and the current stock is going out on the October 31 run. Ordering in the next day or two is the safe play, because it's the last of that batch and the run goes out oldest orders first. Here's the page: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/bitfortun-bs-4

On the price after that, I won't guess a number at you. The increase comes with the move into our own warehouses and the new figure hasn't been set yet, so the only price I can honestly quote you is the $599.99 that's on it today. If you want, order it and I'll keep an eye on your order through the run.

Your H15 Dual price question is still with Georges and his answer comes back to you by email on this thread, so nothing is lost there.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Does it need the PSU upgrade?

Hi Nathan,

No, you don't need one. The B.4 ships with its power supply in the box, a Mean Well LRS-350, 350 watts continuous, 12V, and it takes 100 to 240V with a 115/230V selector switch on it. The power cord is included too. The miner pulls about 300W at the wall, so the 350W unit has the headroom it needs.

All you add is a regular wall socket and your network, either the 2.4 GHz WiFi or an ethernet cable.

So the $599.99 is the whole thing, nothing else to buy. If you order in the next day or two you're on the October 31 run.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
